Definition: Shem, a son of Noah (often includ. his posterity)
BiblicalUsage: Shem was a son of Noah, and the father of the line that leads to Abraham: the list is plain, Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Noah blesses the LORD God of Shem, and Shem lives five hundred years after he begets Arphaxad. His name means name, or renown.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Shem's blessing is the hinge of Genesis. The LORD is the God of Shem, and the promise runs through his line to Abraham and to Christ, and I hold that God chose a family and kept it.
